records.name: account.analytic.line.form.inherit.account
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <data>
                    <xpath expr="//field[@name='amount']" position="after">
                        <field name="ref"/>
                        <field name="partner_id"/>
                    </xpath>
                    <xpath expr="//field[@name='product_uom_id']" position="before">
                        <field name="product_id"/>
                    </xpath>
                    <group name="amount" position="after">
                        <group/> 
                        <group name="accounting" string="Accounting">
                            <field name="move_line_id" options="{'no_create': True}" widget="line_open_move_widget"/>
                            <field name="general_account_id" readonly="move_line_id"/>
                        </group>
                    </group>
                </data>
            </field>

records.name: account.analytic.line.list.inherit.account
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <data>

                        <field name="general_account_id" optional="hide"/>

records.name: account.analytic.line.select.inherit.account
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <data>
                    <xpath expr="//field[@name='date']" position="after">
                        <field name="auto_account_id"/>
                        <field name="account_id"/>
                        <field name="product_id"/>
                        <field name="general_account_id"/>
                        <field name="partner_id" filter_domain="[('partner_id','child_of',self)]"/>
                    </xpath>
                    <xpath expr="//filter[@name='month']" position="after">
                        <filter name="fiscal_date" string="From last fiscal year" domain="[('fiscal_year_search', '=', True)]" invisible="1"/>
                        <separator/>
                        <filter name="profit_loss_accounts" string="P&L Accounts" domain="[('general_account_id.internal_group', 'in', ['income', 'expense'])]"/>
                    </xpath>
                    <xpath expr="//group[@name='groupby']" position="inside">
                        <separator/>
                        <filter name="account_id" context="{'group_by': 'account_id'}"/>
                        <separator/>
                        <filter string="Financial Account" name="group_by_financial_account" context="{'group_by':'general_account_id'}"/>
                        <filter string="Category" name="category" context="{'group_by': 'category'}"/>
                        <filter string="Product" name="product" context="{'group_by':'product_id'}"/>
                        <filter string="Partner" name="partner" context="{'group_by':'partner_id'}"/>
                    </xpath>
                </data>
            </field>

records.name: account.analytic.line.list
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
            <list string="Analytic Items" multi_edit="1" js_class="analytic_list">

<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form string="Analytic Entry">
                    <sheet string="Analytic Entry">
                        <group>

records.name: account.analytic.line.search
records.declaration:
<field name="arch" type="xml">
                <xpath expr="//filter[@name='month']" position="before">
                    <filter name="mine" string="My Timesheets" domain="[('user_id', '=', uid)]"/>
                    <separator/>
                </xpath>
                <filter name="month" position="inside">
                    <filter name="date_this_week" string="This Week" domain="[                         ('date', '>=', '=week_start'),                         ('date', '<', '=week_start +1w'),                     ]"/>
                    <filter name="date_today" string="Today" domain="[('date', '>=', 'today'), ('date', '<', 'today +1d')]"/>
                    <filter name="date_last_week" string="Last Week" domain="[                         ('date', '>=', '=week_start -1w'),                         ('date', '<', '=week_start'),                     ]"/>
                </filter>
                <xpath expr="//group[@name='groupby']" position="before">
                    <field name="employee_id"/>
                    <field name="project_id"/>
                    <field name="task_id"/>
                    <field name="parent_task_id"/>
                    <field name="department_id"/>
                    <field name="manager_id"/>
                </xpath>
                <xpath expr="//group[@name='groupby']" position="inside">
                    <filter string="Project" name="groupby_project" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'project_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Parent Task" name="groupby_parent_task" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'parent_task_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Task" name="groupby_task" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'task_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Department" name="groupby_department" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'department_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Manager" name="groupby_manager" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'manager_id'}"/>
                    <filter string="Employee" name="groupby_employee" domain="[]" context="{'group_by': 'employee_id'}"/>
                </xpath>
            </field>
